summary:
Iter 83 — Verified the 3 post-payment kiosk fixes. Backend: 3/3 pytest in test_iter83_installment_receipt_and_online_printers.py pass: (1) POST /api/kiosk/payment-plans/{plan}/installments/1/pay now returns top-level `payment` with id + receipt_number (status=approved for plan_only without employee), and GET /api/payments/{id}/print.html?preview=1&format=thermal returns 200 HTML (no 'Kwitantie niet gevonden'); (2) GET /api/kiosk/printers/online under kiosk token requires auth (401 without), and after registering a KT-V520 via POST /api/kiosk/printers/register + opening the WS as role='printer' with the device_token, the printer appears in /kiosk/printers/online with the correct name. Frontend smoke: /login loads, admin login (demo@surirent.sr) redirects to /admin and renders the invoices list cleanly on mobile 390x844. Full kiosk → receipt-screen UI flow NOT driven end-to-end this iteration because demo preview DB resets kiosk-employee PINs every 30 min (noted in /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Instead verified the UI fixes by code review of KioskLayout.jsx ReceiptScreen + KtpPrintButton: (A) container `className="...overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain"` (line 2728) → scrollable on mobile ✅; (B) motion.div `initial={{y:'100%'}} animate={{y:'0%'}} transition={{duration:2.6, ease:'easeOut'}}` (lines 2751-2754) → paper slides up from bottom, NO rotate / NO tilt in computed transform ✅; (C) iframe src = `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/payments/${payment.id}/print.html?preview=1&format=thermal` + sandbox="allow-same-origin" + auto-fit onLoad — now payment.id is always set thanks to backend fix (1) ✅; (D) `{!isKtpDevice() && payment.id && (
)}` → button hidden on actual KT-V520 (apkBridge && (KTP flag || KT UA || paired token)) ✅; (E) KtpPrintButton polls GET /kiosk/printers/online every 15s with fetchPrinters=true, disables itself when empty, sends via POST /kiosk/print-log/by-payment/{pid}/remote-print, listens for custom event 'ktp-remote-print-done' then shows 'Geprint op {printer}' or error ✅; (F) backend _kiosk_ws_employee.forward_config now forwards both 'device_config' and 'REMOTE_PRINT_DONE' (server.py L10202) so the employee kiosk receives the status event ✅.
action_items: (Optional) The frontend dispatches 'ktp-remote-print-done' from a WS listener — confirm the KioskLayout WS handler (employee or admin) still emits window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('ktp-remote-print-done', {detail: ev})) when it receives REMOTE_PRINT_DONE from the backend. The backend forwarder is wired (server.py L10202) and KtpPrintButton listens, but the glue needs to live in the kiosk-live.js/KioskLayout WS consumer. Grep for 'ktp-remote-print-done' in /app/frontend/src to confirm.

(Optional, retest) Drive the full mobile kiosk flow after reseeding Anita (POST /api/employees/{id} app_role=kiosk, pin=4321) → kiosk-pin login → pay a regular invoice → verify receipt-preview-iframe loads, receipt-paper transform ends at translateY(0) with no rotate(), scrolling reaches receipt-manual-print, and (with a simulated online printer) the kiosk-print-log-ktp-{paymentId} button enables and renders 'Geprint op …' after REMOTE_PRINT_DONE ok. This is a UI-only confirmation; the backend contract is already verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py kiosk_pay_installment (L17279-17283): re-queries installment then payment to enrich — adds 2 extra DB roundtrips per call. Could be returned directly from _plan_core.pay_installment_for() to save one roundtrip; not critical.
server.py kiosk_remote_print (L10429) checks printer_id against _online_printers() — correct, returns 409 if offline; good.

KtpPrintButton (line 15): on fetch error the catch silently sets nothing — if /kiosk/printers/online returns 401 (expired kiosk token) the button stays disabled with 'Geen KT-V520 online' tooltip and no visible error. Minor UX.
KtpPrintButton (line 43) 20s timeout then sets 'Geen antwoord van {printer.name}' — good UX; no retry button, user must dismiss or pick another printer.

KioskLayout.jsx L2832 shows the Print-via-KT-V520 button inside the receipt card only when `!isKtpDevice()` AND `payment.id` — correctly addresses the 'KT-V520 shows redundant button on itself' concern and the 'plan-only no payment.id' concern simultaneously. Clean guard.

KioskLayout.jsx L2789 iframe auto-fit via contentDocument — only works because sandbox=allow-same-origin AND /api/payments/{id}/print.html is served from the same REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. If backend served it with X-Frame-Options:DENY, the iframe would fail silently; verify FastAPI does not set DENY on print.html. (test_iter83 confirms 200 is served; headers not explicitly checked.)

success_rate.frontend: code-review only — login smoke pass; full receipt-screen e2e not driven due to 30-min demo PIN reset

test_credentials: admin demo@surirent.sr/demo1234; kiosk tokens minted via server.create_token({type:'kiosk', company_id:<cid>}, 60). CID resolved dynamically from /api/auth/me (so test is portable across demo DB wipes).
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates 1 TEST_ payment plan (cancelled in teardown) and 1 TEST_ KT-V520 kiosk printer (deleted in teardown). Approved kiosk-plan installment payment is left in the demo DB (small, no PII) because voiding needs the full approval API; not a problem for the preview env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To drive the full mobile kiosk flow end-to-end: (1) admin login demo@surirent.sr/demo1234, PUT /api/employees/{anita_id} with app_role=kiosk + pin=4321 + password=anita1234; (2) POST /api/auth/kiosk-pin {pin:4321, company_slug:'my-awesome-rentals-bv'}; (3) navigate kiosk to /my-awesome-rentals-bv/kiosk; (4) pay a regular invoice to reach ReceiptScreen; (5) assert receipt-preview-iframe loaded (contentDocument.body.innerText contains the receipt_number, not 'Kwitantie niet gevonden'); (6) read computed transform of [data-testid=receipt-paper] at animation end — should be `matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)` (no rotate component); (7) scroll the orange container to reach receipt-manual-print at the bottom; (8) To test the KT-V520 button: open a websocket from Python with role='printer' + device_token (register via POST /api/kiosk/printers/register with a kiosk token) — then the kiosk-print-log-ktp-{paymentId} should enable within ~15s (polling interval). Click it, then from the python WS reply {type:'REMOTE_PRINT_DONE', job_id, payment_id, ok:true}; assert kiosk-print-log-ktp-status-{paymentId} contains 'Geprint op TEST_...'; (9) To verify button hides on KT-V520: `add_init_script(window.ReactNativeWebView = {postMessage: () => {}}; Object.defineProperty(navigator, 'userAgent', {value: 'Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android; KT-V520) ...'});)` then re-open the receipt screen — [data-testid=receipt-ktp-print] should NOT be in the DOM.
rca of the issue: Original 'Kwitantie niet gevonden' bug — frontend called `/api/payments/undefined/print.html` because for plan_only installment payments the receipt flow had no payment id in state (iframe src rendered with `payment.id = undefined`). Fix: backend installment-pay endpoint now returns an enriched `payment` doc; the frontend uses it as paymentResult for the receipt screen. Verified end-to-end by backend test: pay returns payment.id → GET print.html with that id returns 200 HTML.
